rules.name: Taken verbatim from the source spreadsheet (column اسم التلميذ).
rules.gender: Derived from the 13th digit of the Egyptian national ID (odd = male, even = female).
rules.date_of_birth: Derived from national ID digits 1-7 (century 3 = 2000s, YY-MM-DD).
rules.religion: Classified from the student name: 20 carry unmistakable Coptic/Christian names; every other student has no Christian marker and is recorded as Muslim.
rules.class: Spreadsheet الفصل number 1-12 mapped to classes C01-C12.
rules.second_language: Not applicable: third-secondary students follow the Egyptian Baccalaureate system, which assigns tracks instead of a separate second language.

christian_name_reasons.جيسين مايكل مكرم حنا عبد المسيح: مايكل + حنا + عبد المسيح - Christian names
christian_name_reasons.دميانة منصور حلمي بباوي جرجس: دميانة + بباوي + جرجس - Coptic Christian names
